facts.fact: Agence Ecofin, citing official sources, reports that of 1,700 white zones identified in Burkina Faso 183 were covered in 2022 and 138 in 2024, with 750 planned for 2025 and the 2026 work plan of the digital ministry continuing coverage of the 750 white zones.
Agence Ecofin reports that the digital ministry's 2025 results included strengthening the digital skills of 169 young girls.

BFA.note: Only support to dematerialise 100 procedures is planned for 2026, with no service launched or piloted stated.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that in 2025 the national fibre optic network was extended to more than 11,292 km, with a further 270 km of fibre planned for 2026 in the digital ministry's work plan.
